t: 蒙古人开始围攻金朝首都开封。
te: The Mongols begin their siege on Kaifeng, the capital of the Jin dynasty.
dz: 蒙金战争：蒙古人开始围攻金朝首都开封。
de: Mongol–Jin War: The Mongols begin their siege on Kaifeng, the capital of the Jin dynasty.

dz: 西班牙城镇阿尔乔纳宣布独立,并命名其本土的穆罕默德·伊本·优素福为统治者. 这标志着穆罕默德第一次上升到显要地位;他后来建立了格拉纳达的纳斯里德酋长国,是西班牙最后一个独立的穆斯林国家.
de: The Spanish town of Arjona declares independence and names its native Muhammad ibn Yusuf as ruler. This marks the Muhammad's first rise to prominence; he later established the Nasrid Emirate of Granada, the last independent Muslim state in Spain.

dz: 镰仓幕府的北条康时颁布了《御成拜式目》，这是日本第一部管理武士阶级的法律法规。
de: Shikken Hojo Yasutoki of the Kamakura shogunate promulgates the Goseibai Shikimoku, the first Japanese legal code governing the samurai class.
